content.comment_body: Hello, I would like some help with a technical problem. How can I set up a device so that an analog input receiving 0-10 volts produces an inversely proportional output voltage? Specifically, when the input is 10 volts, the output should be 0 volts; if the input is 8 volts, the output should be 2 volts, and so forth. Thank you.
Hello, use an analog amplifier with a gain of -1 and an offset of 1000.
Analog input: 0-10 volt. Analog output: 10-0 volt. For example: Analog input 0V gives output 10V; input 1V gives output 9V; input 2V gives output 8V, and so on.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to configure an automation device to translate a 0-10V analog input into an inversely proportional output (10-0V). Responses discuss possible methods, but highlight uncertainty or lack of clarity in documentation regarding the exact approach for setting up such signal conversions easily.
